verdict.rationale: Munito AI's docs list streaming among its capabilities. It exposes OpenAI Chat Completions/Responses and Anthropic Messages-compatible APIs, which implies the standard token-by-token SSE streaming of those protocols. The evidence for this is a single capability-list mention, so depth is thin. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the SSE event format and token-level chunking, streaming code examples, latency/time-to-first-token figures, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior.
